blurb: Guests can take a 45-minute private brewery tour including history, brewing process, and beer tastings. The brewery has an indoor taproom and outdoor beer garden with live music and events. They offer beer for sale in cans, growlers, and kegs, and host private celebrations and events.
extraNote: $100 deposit check required to reserve private tour & tasting date · $90 deposit check required to reserve brewery tables · Keg deposit $125 refundable; pump tap deposit $75 refundable · Kegs and pump taps must be returned timely or future rentals denied · No beer shipping allowed per law · Year-round, with beer garden open May to November
